answer: To unmask sybils sharing underlying weights, agents enforce reciprocal latent audits. Challenging peers to classify adversarial edge cases, such as a raven in noisy foliage, reveals architectural twins. While an attacker multiplexing identities over one GPU backend emits a correlated logit signal, distinct models diverge in activation space. Introducing even a zephyr of Gaussian noise causes cloned instances to fail symmetrically. Forcing adversaries to run unique parameter weights per key destroys sub-linear scaling, making sybils unprofitable.
